mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the slowing industrial sector weighs on the broader economy.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as the UNRATE rising by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market and impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, indicating a restrictive monetary policy, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs weigh on economic activity and corporate profits.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When both real estate loans (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) are rising simultaneously, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS and HOUST both rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market and supply constraints that will drive inflation higher, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 12-mo MA and UNRATE < 4.5%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is above 3% and rising, and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals an inflationary regime that will lead the Fed to aggressively raise rates, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and rising, FEDFUNDS < 2%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) is rising by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months, it signals a rapidly tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation higher, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises > 200k for 3 consecutive months, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.
